en.name: TP-Link Archer AX55
en.shortDescription: Wi-Fi 6 dual-band router, AX3000, four gigabit LAN ports.
en.description:
## TP-Link Archer AX55

AX3000 dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router for homes and small offices.

- 2402 Mbps on 5 GHz + 574 Mbps on 2.4 GHz
- Four gigabit LAN ports and one gigabit WAN
- OFDMA and MU-MIMO for many devices at once
- WPA3 security and parental controls
